name: everlast-lm
description: Spec-driven, agent-built re-implementation of Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) on Google Cloud
author: Lukas Zech

scripts.infra:init:local: terraform -chdir=infra/environments/dev init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/staging init -backend=false && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/prod init -backend=false
scripts.infra:validate: terraform -chdir=infra/environments/dev validate && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/staging validate && terraform -chdir=infra/environments/prod validate
